messages:
maya: Quick question — thinking about an opt-in client "shape hint" for the embeddings route to help routing + quota accuracy. e.g. header `X-Embed-Shape: dims=1024,count=8` or `Embed-Units: 96`. Worth trying?

alex: +1 on trying but big caveat: clients lie/misestimate all the time. we should treat it as advisory, not authoritative. validate against observed bytes/dims and fallback.

sam: If we give a price incentive for sending the hint (lower unit cost) ppl will game it. prefer using the hint to *improve routing* (fastpath) but not change billing unless we can verify.

danielle: Console/telemetry note: we need side-by-side metrics: declared vs observed dims/count and a mismatch alert. otherwise CS will call us when invoices vary.

leo: Example header we discussed in the proto review:
```
X-Embed-Shape: dims=1536;count=4;format=packed
Embed-Units: 6144
```
runtime would still recompute actual units from payload and log `embed.client_declared_units` and `embed.observed_units`.

natalie: Implementation plan i'd suggest: 1) accept hint as opt-in beta, 2) runtime uses declared for routing heuristics (binning into small/medium/large buckets), 3) billing uses observed by default, 4) if declared==observed for N requests from a tenant, allow a verified override. also add a canary flag so we can roll this out to 10% traffic.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for `embed-shape-hint` feature to eu-west-1 at 2025-07-14T09:00Z (10% traffic). :rocket:

alex: Metrics to add: `embed.hint_usage_rate`, `embed.hint_mismatch_ratio`, `embed.hint_verified_overrides`. We should also tag spans when routing differs because of hint so traces show causality.

maya: Love the verified override idea. actionable items:
- natalie to add runtime flag + canary toggle
- danielle to mock console cards showing declared vs observed per-tenant (link: https://go/console/mock/shape-hint) :eyes:
- alex to add the telemetry + alerts PR
- leo to update SDK docs with header examples and warnings

Let's run 1 week canary (eu only) and check `embed.hint_mismatch_ratio` < 3% before widening. i'll open a PR with the draft console mockups and the docs snippet.

sam: one more thought — client library should expose a helper that computes the hint from local tensors to reduce misreports. we can ship that first to reduce noise.

maya: Agreed. thanks all — i'll create the tracking ticket and drop the PR link here when ready.
